summary: The diff updates the wallet UI and React Query hooks to improve validation and error handling while still calling backend.getBalance(principal) and backend.transfer(to, amount). However, the provided backend/main.mo diff snippet does not show implementation of an ICRC-1-compatible ledger, ICRC-1 endpoints, upgrade-stable persistence, or one-time initial minting to the specified owner principal.
